design.purpose: A warm two-colour chunky lap throw for one person seated on a sofa or chair. Uses green yarn for the first half and blue yarn for the second half.

steps.c: Place green yarn on the work surface
Place blue yarn beside the green yarn
Ch 21 with green yarn and 15 mm hook
Row 1: sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch, 20 sc
Rows 2 to 6: ch 1, turn, 20 sc each row
Rows 7 to 12: ch 1, turn, 20 sc each row
Join blue in last stitch of row 12, ch 1
Rows 13 to 18: ch 1, turn, 20 sc each row
Rows 19 to 24: ch 1, turn, 20 sc each row
Fasten off, leaving a 15 cm blue tail
Snip the green tail to 15 cm at colour change
Weave in all ends with yarn needle
